"""Long preambles and lexicographic choice among many equal-cost paths."""
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

N = 3000
states = ["P%04d" % i for i in range(N + 1)]
types = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": states},
         {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 1},
         {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]],
            "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
transitions = [{"from": states[i], "to": states[i + 1], "command": "s%04d" % i,
                "cost": 3, "when": None} for i in range(N)]
machine = {"states": states, "initial": states[0], "state_param": "st",
           "message_param": "msg", "transitions": transitions}
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in
     zip(plan["slots"], [N, ord("z"), 0])])}]
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
elapsed = time.time() - start
corpus = out["corpus"][0]
print("chain %d states: %.2fs cost=%s commands=%d head=%s tail=%s" % (
    N, elapsed, corpus["cost"], len(corpus["commands"]),
    corpus["commands"][:2], corpus["commands"][-2:]))
assert corpus["cost"] == 3 * N
assert corpus["commands"][:N] == ["s%04d" % i for i in range(N)]
assert corpus["commands"][N] == "z"

# many equal-cost paths: the lexicographically smallest sequence must win
states2 = ["Q%d" % i for i in range(12)]
types2 = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": states2},
          {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 0},
          {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules2 = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]],
             "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
items = []
# a 3-cube of cost-1 transitions; commands differ per edge
for level in range(3):
    for src in range(8):
        dst = ((src & ~(1 << level)) | (1 << level)) if not (src & (1 << level)) else src
        dst = src | (1 << level)
        for choice in range(2):
            items.append({"from": "Q%d" % src, "to": "Q%d" % dst,
                          "command": "%s%d" % ("ab"[choice], level),
                          "cost": 1 + choice, "when": None})
# make every level-3 path cost identical by only allowing the cheap command
items = [t for t in items if t["command"].startswith("a")]
machine2 = {"states": states2, "initial": "Q0", "state_param": "st",
            "message_param": "msg", "transitions": items}
campaign2 = {"types": types2, "modules": modules2, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
             "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine2, "runs": []}
_, plan2 = kit.plan_for(campaign2)
campaign2["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan2["slots"], [7, 0])])}]
out2 = kit.run_cli(campaign2)
corpus2 = out2["corpus"][0]
print("cube:", out2["records"], corpus2["commands"], corpus2["cost"])
assert corpus2["cost"] == 3 and corpus2["commands"] == ["a0", "a1", "a2", ""]
print("LONG OK")
PYEOF
